arguments.text: Fixed: required flags no longer get an implicit False default, so a missing required flag now reports "Missing option '--flag'" (and multiple flags default to ()). Full suite still green (488 passed).

Fixed: _compat._make_cached_stream_func returns None when there is no stream, echo() returns early, and ProgressBar/pager fall back to a dummy file. click.echo with sys.stdout/stderr = None no longer raises. Suite green.
Fixed: the argument decorator now copies attrs before popping cls, so cls is preserved when used multiple times. Suite green.
Fixed: Path(resolve_path=True) now resolves symlinks with pathlib.Path.resolve() instead of readlink+realpath (which mis-resolved relative symlink targets). Suite green.
